title: The Theorem of Pythagoras: Solving Problems
seo_title: Grade 9 Theorem of Pythagoras Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Solve problems using the Theorem of Pythagoras to calculate a missing length in a right-angled triangle, leaving irrational answers in surd form; use the theorem to solve problems involving unknown lengths in geometric figures that contain right-angled triangles.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 9 Pythagoras worksheets: the hypotenuse, shorter sides, right-angle tests and problems. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • c² = a² + b², where c is the hypotenuse.
  • Shorter side: a² = c² − b².
  • Take the square root at the end.
  • If a² + b² = c², the triangle is right-angled.

Examples

Example

A 5 m ladder, foot 1,4 m from the wall

h² = 25 − 1,96

Answer: h = 4,8 m

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding for a short sideSubtract.
No square rootc² = 169 means c = 13.
The wrong hypotenusec is opposite the right angle.
